verdict.rationale: Probes confirm Modal serves a live llms.txt (HTTP 200, a 'Modal Documentation' index) and markdown versions of its doc pages (e.g. /docs/guide/gpu.md). Modal also distributes an official SKILL.md to help coding agents use its latest features, so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-oriented docs. missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the llms.txt scope and coverage, independent hands-on corroboration of agents consuming it

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://modal.com/llms.txt # Modal Documentation
PROBE docs-md: HTTP 200 at https://modal.com/docs/guide/gpu.md # GPU acceleration
Modal distributes an [official skill](./py/modal/skills/modal/SKILL.md) to help coding agents use its latest features.
